notes: macOS 26.6 on Apple M4 Pro, Rhino 8.35 with Ladybug Tools 1.9.0, existing Rhino profile, foton-daylight 0.3.1 installed editable into a fresh venv in the release-0.3.1 worktree, Radiance 5.4a. Bundle: dist/foton-grasshopper-0.3.1.zip from scripts/package_grasshopper.py. install: the three .ghuser files in the bundle are byte-identical to those already in the Grasshopper UserObjects folder (checked with cmp), so they were not copied again; the component server lists all three under HB-Foton. open_example, run, rerun, change_inputs, upgrade_invalidates_reuse, reload_moved_results, cancel: scripts/check_grasshopper.py run inside Rhino through the Rhino MCP Python runner against the extracted 0.3.1 bundle, all seven checks passed and the Settings component reported engine 0.3.1 on metal (rhino-smoke.json). honeybee_metrics: HB Annual Daylight Metrics read Foton's results folder for the bundle's shoebox example and returned DA identical to Foton's own DA on all 36 sensors (max difference 0.0 pp). ladybug_heatmap: LB Spatial Heatmap built its mesh and 36 colours from those DA values with no errors or warnings. Not covered: a fresh Rhino profile, a fresh UserObjects install, Windows.
